items.abstract: Passive acoustic sensing offers a critical, cost-efficient, and, crucially, passive alternative for detecting small unmanned aerial vehicles. However, the practical deployment of acoustic systems is discouraged by extreme environmental noise and sensor-induced domain shift caused by heterogeneous hardware. This paper addresses these challenges by introducing a robust framework optimized for real-world battlefield conditions. We propose the integration of Per-Channel Energy Normalization (PCEN) and attention-based…

items.originalTitle: Participatory Moral AI Is Not Neutral: The Invisible Hand of Developers
items.summary: 在道德偏好elicitation中，开发者的三个关键选择（特征范围、选民抽样、问题框架）在三个部署情境中影响偏好结果。研究显示道德特征跨情境变化，政治意识形态影响约三分之一特征的偏好，且问题措辞可改变意识形态差距。结果表明投票式对齐无法仅靠聚合实现公平透明AI。
items.abstract: As AI systems make more morally loaded decisions across society, one response has been moral preference elicitation. In this approach, researchers poll participants on hypothetical dilemmas and use the aggregated votes to train a policy that an AI model then applies at scale. Before any vote is cast, developers make three key choices in the moral AI elicitation pipeline: feature scoping, voter sampling, and question framing. In other words, they decide which features go to a vote, which voters to include, and how…
keyFacts: 开发者决策如何影响道德AI偏好诱导的结果？

However, cytometry data is highly heterogeneous and unstandardized due to experimental protocols and the choice of measured features. While machine learning methods hold the potential to gain deeper insights into cell biology, these challenges make them difficult to apply and transfer across studies. Recent advances in foundatio…

Seven models (six open-weight; gpt-4o-mini) each chose among five synthetic family-medicine physician cards whose attributes were independently randomize…
keyFacts: 在大语言模型辅助的医生选择中，哪些因素（如声誉、费用、人口统计学信号）因果性地影响推荐结果？

items.summary: 冻结语言模型在推理任务上有两个弱点：未充分利用残差流中的证据，且无法检测输入不足而胡编。本文结合条件引导探针和零样本充分性方向，提出YOPO系统，在单次前向传播中同时实现回答、引导和弃权。通过训练小网络重构引导前的残差，避免两次前向传播。在Qwen2.5等十个骨干上，YOPO的三路准确率超过两遍参考方法，并首次提出回答或弃权基准。
